messages:
marta: heads-up — I'm seeing a rising cluster of SMART/wear anomalies on local NVMe in us-east1 scratchpool-3. GPU attaches are getting held for nodes with high 'surface-noise' score. past hour trend looks spiky. anyone oncall or watching storage?

raj: also noticed a small bump in attach failures at 09:24. assumed transient but counts creep up. can you paste a sample?

marta: paste below from node gnode-ue3-42 (nvme-cli / smartctl snippets):
```
# nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1
critical_warning: 0x0
temperature: 43 C
available_spare: 100%
available_spare_threshold: 5%
data_units_read: 1234567
data_units_written: 2345678
host_read_commands: 987654321
host_write_commands: 876543210
media_errors: 12
num_err_log_entries: 27
# wear_leveling_info: media_wear_percentage: 46%
# custom surface-noise-meter: spike=0.18 -> 0.86 in last 20m
```

marta: iostat snapshot:
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await
nvme0n1         1.2    450   24.0  9216    12.8
```

storage-bot: [alert] nvme-surface-noise threshold exceeded on pool scratchpool-3 in region us-east1. nodes_marked: 6. auto-drain suggested.

ian: ok — surface-noise is our term for contiguous media read errors + requeue latency. 6 nodes marked means attach backpressure. can we repro by running a quick fio pattern on a spare node?

marta: fio repro queued, running short randread 30s on gnode-ue3-99. initial results show high tail latencies and occasional EIOs.

selene: if this is correlated to wear percentage rising to ~45-50%, we should avoid mass replacement — capacity hit is big. prefer mitigations: slow down janitor scrubs, throttle background GC, route new attaches to other pools, and mark nodes for low-priority repairs.

raj: cost note — routing to other regions will increase egress and warmup time. how many attaches are being blocked right now?

marta: ~120 attach attempts blocked in the last 15m across batch and interactive GPU queues. blocking latency is causing ~3% job failures.

ian: immediate mitigation plan:
- reduce janitor concurrency on scratchpool-3 from 8 -> 2
- disable nightly deep-scrub for 2 windows (ops-bot will apply)
- enable attach fallback routing to scratchpool-1/us-west1 for non-latency-critical jobs
- run targeted per-node fio + smartctl and collect core dumps if EIOs continue

ops-bot: applying config change: janitor.concurrency=scratchpool-3:2 (rolling) — ETA 5m

marta: starting fallback routing for batch job class now (15m window). will monitor attach drain.

selene: +1 to throttling scrubs. also add these nodes to 'repair-low' instead of immediate replace; we can stagger replacements over next 2 weeks to smooth cost.

raj: please tag any jobs re-routed with billing tag `storage-fallback-uswest` so we can track cost delta.

marta: done. adding tag and creating a small dashboard to track egress/cost, attach latency, and job failures. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/scratchpool3-fallback (watch only for now)

ian: open a quick ops ticket? put initial diagnostics + node list. I'll join oncall handoff in 10m.

marta: ticket #OPS-4829 created with node list and fio artifacts. attaching sample dmesg + SMART logs.

storage-bot: automated remediation suggestion: postpone non-critical scrubs, mark nodes with noise_score>0.7 for deferred replacement, and increase read-retry backoff to reduce requeue storms.

selene: agree with backoff tweak — reduces transient EIO cascades. but we need to watch latency SLOs for interactive workloads; map routing policy accordingly.

raj: timeline ask — how long until attach queue clears with these mitigations?

marta: initial effect seen within ~8 minutes after lowering janitor concurrency and enabling fallback: attach queue dropped from 120 -> 18. I'll keep monitoring for next hour.

ian: solid. after 1h we'll re-evaluate whether to schedule node replacements or continue deferred approach. if media_errors climb or EIOs persist, escalate to hardware replacement.

selene: note for follow-up: run wearmap correlation across regions to see if fleet firmware batch pushed last month correlates. file as investigation item for storage team.

marta: thanks all — ping me if attach failures creep back. :thumbsup:
